news.headline:
MTAR Technologies management will meet various analysts and institutional investors on November 17 and 18, 2026.

The interactions will include in-person and virtual one-on-one and group meetings held in Mumbai.

Source: BSE

news.headline:
Lotus Eye Hospital reported a Q2 net profit of Rs 44.0 lakh, up from Rs 11.6 lakh year-on-year.

Quarterly revenue from operations rose to Rs 1,772.4 lakh compared to Rs 1,303.8 lakh in the previous year.

Source: BSE
